intro: King Llane Wrynn I was the ruler of Stormwind during the catastrophic First War, whose reign ended with the fall of the kingdom and his own tragic murder. A beloved and proud monarch, his steadfast refusal to believe his friend Medivh had betrayed humanity ultimately doomed his defense of the capital.

p: Born to King Barathen Wrynn, young Prince Llane grew up alongside Anduin Lothar and Medivh. When the Gurubashi trolls staged gruesome raids against Westfall settlements, Llane defied his father's defensive policies and led his companions into the jungles of Stranglethorn Vale to slay the warlord Jok'non. This bold defiance ignited an all-out Gurubashi invasion. Though Barathen perished leading a desperate counterattack outside the city gates, Medivh intervened with devastating sorcery to annihilate the troll vanguard. In the wake of this costly victory, Llane ascended to the throne as Stormwind's king.

When mysterious, green-skinned creatures emerged from the southern swamps, King Llane dispatched Lothar to investigate the Black Morass. What began as minor skirmishes erupted into the First War as the Horde overran Brightwood, Westfall, and Redridge. Messengers sent to Lordaeron and other northern human kingdoms were dismissed, their pleas undermined by Stormwind's historic isolationism and aristocratic intrigue. Despite these disadvantages, Llane organized an audacious counterattack alongside Lothar that broke the Horde's initial siege of Stormwind, dealing the invaders their first major defeat.
